G2 exempts only a panic line at exactly `src/cmd/hook/seam.rs:<digits>` (founder ratification, Decisions Log `2026-09-28`). Another seam or environment read, a colour fact changing a control or reaching a log line, error or refusal, or another G2 exemption, needs a Decisions Log entry. Never add an env, flag or feature seam to force a refusing peer-euid decision: one account can make no foreign peer, so the decisions are proven over injected values (`peer_euid_admitted`, `serve_admitting`).

- NEVER let `config.json`, a `VIOLA_*` env var or a flag switch off a control. The two env carve-outs are the test seams `FAKE_AGENT_PUMP_DELAY_MS` (capped at 5 s) and `FAKE_AGENT_HOOK_PANIC` (exact `1`, forced fail-open hook panic; G2 exempts only its exact file path), both only under `fake-agent`, absent from release builds, switching off nothing; `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` is read by the channel endpoint only to place the socket directory, and by `viola verify` once, held in memory and used only to compose the claude CLI's inbox socket address for the sender's prompt (it enters no log line, stamp, error or step line, nor any fixture file verify writes of its own); `viola verify` and the start of `run` and `revive` read `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`'s value, only when `claude_env_keep` keeps that name, to choose the Claude config holding the trust record; the terminal colour facts `NO_COLOR`, `TERM` and `COLORTERM` are read in every build, only by `viola list`'s human mode and only to choose whether and how deep SGR bytes are written — they switch off no control, widen no redaction and are not a configuration channel (the founder's own word, chunk 2026-10-17-cli-output-discipline); another seam or environment read, or a colour fact changing a control or reaching a log line, error or refusal, needs its own Decisions Log entry.
